comments.comment: AGENTS.md says to prefer short sentences and, for one that runs past about 25 words, to find the seam; this line holds 45 or more words with no full stop, question mark, or exclamation mark
comments.failureScenario: The progress-log entry holds one sentence of 60 words. A reader must carry the whole claim to its end, and AGENTS.md asks for a split past about 25 words.
